{{Top|leg}}
The '''KV457-C thruster component''' was produced by [[Keizar-Volvec/Legends|Keizar-Volvec]] during the the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Designed for [[Starship/Legends|starship]] thrusters, the component allowed for precision control over a ship's maneuvering thrusters and thus giving a faster turning rate.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Galactic Starfighter]]'' {{1st}}
